library.readOnlyBanner: Read-only mode — viewing & streaming only. Changes are disabled by the host.
library.emptyBody: No downloads match this filter. Tap <bold>{{addLabel}}</bold> to queue a URL, magnet, or torrent.
library.confirmRemoveWithData: Delete the downloaded files from disk too? This permanently removes them and can't be undone.

toast.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the text manually

history.subtitle: Completed & removed downloads. Re-queue any of them in one click.

detail.emptyBody: Pick a download to see its files, peers, progress and options.

progress.hint: Live piece/segment data appears here while the transfer runs.

addDialog.title: Add download
addDialog.urlLabel: URL, magnet, FTP or SFTP link
addDialog.urlHint: Paste multiple lines to batch-add. Torrents/files download to the server running Goel°.
addDialog.modeAutoSplit: Automatic — split across every eligible interface
addDialog.modeAutoDefault: Automatic — use the system default route
addDialog.modeSingle: Send it all through one interface
addDialog.splitHint: This machine has {{count}} usable interfaces. Splitting only helps when each has its own upstream link — two adapters behind the same router share one pipe and are usually slower together than the faster one alone.
addDialog.enterUrl: Enter a URL or magnet first

folderPicker.title: Choose a folder
folderPicker.useOrCreate: Use this folder, or make a new one.

settings.subtitle: These apply to your browser. Server options (port, sign-in, password) are managed in the desktop app under Settings → Web Access.

theme.name: Web theme
theme.desc: Independent of the desktop app — this choice is remembered in <bold>this browser</bold> only. The desktop sets the default a new browser starts with.

access.name: Access
access.descReadOnly: This session can view and stream but not change downloads.
access.descFull: This session can add, remove, and manage downloads.

desktop.name: Managed on the desktop
desktop.desc: Port, sign-in username/password, LAN access, read-only, and session length live in the app (Settings → Web Access). A native folder picker, Reveal in Finder, clipboard capture, and notifications also stay on the Mac running Goel°.

network.readError: Could not read the network configuration.
network.splitDesc: Opens connections on several interfaces at once. Faster only when each interface has its own upstream link — two adapters behind the same router share one pipe and are usually slower together than the faster one alone.
network.splitDescSingle: This machine has one usable interface, so there is nothing to split across.
network.lockedDesc: GOEL_AGGREGATION is set in <path>/etc/goel/config</path>, so a change made here is reverted the next time the service restarts. Run <cmd>goel config set aggregation on|off</cmd> on the server to make it permanent.
network.interfacesDesc: Ticked interfaces are the ones a split may use. Leave them all ticked to use every eligible one.
network.streamsDesc: More streams help on high-latency links and hurt against servers that throttle per connection.
network.applyDesc: Applies to new downloads; running ones keep the interfaces they started on.
